calculation.description: Fades each asset's latest daily return, increasing reversal exposure when observation-only VIX is unusually stressed. All inputs are available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.055374), 2023-2024 (0.031892), and 2025-2027 (0.033324). Five-day IC was 0.029413 with ICIR 0.083377; ten-day performance was weaker. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
